content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in a [product_name] base module with display that has 12 digital inputs and 8 digital outputs. I selected a base [product_name] ([article_no]) which provides 8 DI and 4 DO, and a digital expansion module ([article_no]) that adds 4 DI and 4 DO. However, when using the configurator, selecting the digital expansion module automatically adds an analog module ([product_name], [article_no]). Could you confirm if it is necessary to include the analog module if I only need the digital expansion module?

It is not possible to directly connect a 24VDC digital expansion module to a 230VAC base module (or 230VAC expansion module). The 24VDC expansion module can only be connected to 230VAC modules with an analog module in between. This is why the selection tool automatically includes the analog module.
Thank you [user_name]. I will choose the 230VAC digital expansion module (4DI & 4DO, [article_no]). Now, I do not need any additional module for interposing.

Without an analog expansion module, you can only use these two digital expansion units: [product_name] expansion unit [product_name] ([article_no]), and [product_name] expansion unit [product_name] ([article_no]).

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing uncertainty with the configuration tool, as it automatically adds an analog module when only digital modules are selected. This highlights a lack of clear guidance regarding compatibility and technical requirements between module types and voltage levels. This can lead to user confusion and hesitation in the selection process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users prefer to have the ability to select only the required digital expansion modules for their configuration, without being forced to include analog modules unless they are technically necessary.
